project_type: Python robotics package normakit (NormaCore Station, ElRobot 8-DoF ST3215 follower arm, MuJoCo/pybullet sim)
build_system: venv at .venv (symlink to hacklab-normacore-kit), no build step
verification_instructions: Run selftest_sim.py; run new dry-run client test against the server in --dummy mode (no GPU, no hardware)
environment_constraints: This laptop has no working NVIDIA driver. NEVER send motion to real hardware (AGENTS.md). Never write secrets (~/.gemini_er_key, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) into files/logs. Server runs on a remote A100 whose host is unknown: use placeholders/env vars (A100_HOST), no invented credentials. Existing uncommitted work in the tree (kin.py, station_backend.py, vision.py, docs/HANDOVER.md etc.) belongs to the team: do not revert or commit it; stage only your own files.
contribution_requirements: Document changes in CHANGELOG.md; problems in docs/ISSUES.md; terse docs
key_patterns: Backend ABC in src/normakit/core.py (state()->ArmState with JointState.norm 0..1, send_goals(dict jid->norm, speed), frame_jpeg()); Guard.move() clamps (0.02..0.98), step-limit 0.35 for non-gripper, 10 Hz rate limit, overcurrent estop; joints 1..8, 8=gripper. LeRobot dataset v3 from scripts/record_demo.py: observation.state(8), action(8) normalized 0..1, observation.images.table 640x480, fps 30. sim_backend.SimBackend(realtime=False) has same interface as StationBackend.
directory_structure: src/normakit (lib), scripts/ (CLIs), docs/, tools/, calibration/, run/, assets/mujoco
